notes: Fiscal year 2025 ended January 26, 2025 (matches data.js fy 'Jan 2025'). Ownership is from the 2025 proxy (filed May 13, 2025), as of March 24, 2025, on 24,456,668,546 shares outstanding. Huang's 922,922,938 shares include family trusts and partnerships, plus 63,793,830 shares held by The Jen-Hsun & Lori Huang Foundation, in which the proxy says he and his wife have no pecuniary interest. The proxy names him Jen-Hsun Huang. VANGUARD and BLACKROCK percentages are stale: the proxy bases them solely on Schedules 13G/A reporting holdings as of December 29 and December 31, 2023 (split-adjusted for the June 2024 ten-for-one split), divided by the March 2025 share count. STOCK COMP is the cash-flow add-back ($4,737m); the Note 3 table totals the same $4,737m for fiscal 2025. GEOGRAPHY is by customer billing location; the 10-K says Singapore is mostly an invoicing hub and shipments to Singapore were under 2% of revenue. Segment values rounded from millions; they sum to 130.50.
